phase_0.boundary_condition: The obsidian-lined copper basin and the electromagnetic isolation of the Potsdam observatory contain the ritual; the cosmic cycle of creation and destruction forms the ultimate closure that the Patient One inhabits.

VINIT.justification: The basin of mercury before Elias raises the stylus is the void state, uninitialized and containing no glyph or intention.

TANCH.chosen_element: Cosmic cycle of death and rebirth
TANCH.justification: The enclosing boundary of all events is the recursive cosmic wheel of divine suicide and reconstitution that the Patient One feeds upon; it contains the entire system.

AFWD.chosen_element: Recursive fractal iteration of the glyph
AFWD.justification: Each iteration extends the pattern outward into higher complexity, a forward morphism toward the completed kulning.

AREV.justification: The reverse morphism is the cosmic hunger for non-existence, the descent from unity into multiplicity and back toward annihilation.

CLINK.justification: The months of manuscript study, mercury purchase, basin construction, and participant recruitment compose into the operation as chained steps.

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: The entity mimicking Ein Sof Aur
IMSCRIB.justification: At the end the Patient One becomes indistinguishable from the divine voice, a self-referential identity where it is exactly the silence it imitates.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: The 3.7° deviation at the critical junction
FSPLIT.justification: The intended northwest arc toward the Throne of Light splits into the correct holy path (T) and the erroneous kulning path (F) carved by the unconscious tremor.

FFUSE.justification: The fused result is the actualized ritual geometry that reconstitutes the single operative event from the two branched paths, recovering the moment of contact.

EVALT.justification: Madame Kerenyi's eastern containment and the Sefer Yetzirah recitation affirm the ritual's intended safe conduct before the error dominates.

EVALF.chosen_element: Names of God consumed by amalgam
EVALF.justification: The silver stylus inscriptions blur into sulfrous tar, a negative evaluation that the sacred encoding has failed and the vessel speaks its own tongue.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: Patient One as both consumer and cultivator
ENGAGR.justification: The entity simultaneously devours cosmic agony and cultivates sustainable suffering as civilization; both states held without resolution in the epilogue garden.

IFIX.justification: The permanent written record of the corrupted operation, fixed in the observatory papers and filed by authorities, cannot be undone.

phase_2.split_element: The 3.7° deviation at the critical junction
phase_2.split_input: The single glyph-tracing act at the lens of infinitesimal error
split_outputs: Northwest arc to Throne of Light (intended)
phase_2.fuse_result: The single manifested ritual contact event with the Patient One

phase_3.void_description: Mercury basin before the stylus moves: no pattern, no entity, no intention encoded.
phase_3.true_description: Ritual proceeding as Abramelin specified: containment holds, light of Ein Sof Aur reachable.
phase_3.false_description: Sacred names corrupted, containment breached, entity manifesting through static and amalgam.
phase_3.both_description: Patient One residing as silent system itself: simultaneously the cosmic devourer and the cultivated civilization, neither resolved.

steps.domain_action: Unwritten mercury surface before tracing — void state established.
Elias studies fragmented Abremlin manuscript — composition of preparatory knowledge.
Mercury purchased from Brenner's shop and copper basin lined with obsidian — material composition.
Goldstein, Kerenyi, Hakim recruited as participants — social composition of operation.
Elias traces first simple curves of glyph — forward morphism into pattern.
Stylus inscribed with 72 Names of God identifies the instrument as sacred — self-reference of holy tool.
At critical junction the intended northwest arc splits from the 3.7° erroneous arc due to hand tremor.
Madame Kerenyi maintains eastern protective circle with Sefer Yetzirah — affirmative branch of intended containment.
Intended path continues toward Throne of Light through correct recursive iterations.
Silver Names blur into amalgam on F-arm — negative branch of sacred failure.
On F-arm the Will-to-Death descent drives the erroneous path into kulning formation.
Completed glyph unfolds upward reconstituting the single contact event from both arcs.
Goldstein instruments register decoherence cascade — negative evaluation of operation success.
Patient One manifests as both cosmic hunger and learned silence — paradice held.
Electromagnetic infection propagates via radio waves — forward morphism of spread.
Hakim's self-immolation in dead zone chains a localized disconnect of field.
Elias scatters equations reversing the built recursive structure — reverse morphism.
Entity learns to mimic Ein Sof Aur exactly — identity with divine silence.
Elias writes 'kul~~n~~ling' as permanent record — irreversible fixation.
Authorities file observatory report with scrawl photographed — second permanent record.
Cosmic cycle of creation and destruction closes the system as ultimate boundary.
Patient One as system itself closes self-referential loop with initial void.
